algorithm: xxh3-64, default seed 0, no custom secret
hash_format: %016x — lowercase hex, zero-padded to exactly 16 chars
key_format: jm1:<hash>:<size>  (substitute _ for : on filesystems that reject it, e.g. exFAT)
input_order: size as 8-byte LITTLE-ENDIAN uint64 — always, including for an empty file
head: min(1048576, size) bytes from offset 0 — skipped only when size == 0
tail: exactly 1048576 bytes from offset (size - 1048576) — ONLY when size > 2097152
notes: For 1048576 < size <= 2097152 the head is capped AND the tail is skipped, so bytes past 1 MiB are not hashed. Deliberate; see spec 3.1.
A short read of either window is an ERROR, never a zero-padded buffer (spec 3.2).
The hash half is byte-identical to the source_hash/asset_key already on the wire.

vectors.covers: empty file — the length prefix alone
tiny file — whole file is the head
head capped at one window; still no tail
1.5 MiB — the bytes past 1 MiB are NOT hashed
exactly two windows — NOT > 2 windows, so still no tail
first size where the tail engages
head + tail with a clear unhashed gap between
